title: Research Wiki Frontmatter
description: Frontmatter schema for knowledge/**/*.md pages in research projects using the research-superpowers plugin. Single source of truth — consumed by scripts/lint-wiki.py and VS Code yaml.schemas, referenced by skills.

type.description: Page type. entity = person/place/artefact/institution; concept = theory/method/term; source = cited work; synthesis = cross-source argument.

created.description: ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Set once at creation.

updated.description: ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Bump on every substantive edit.

status.description: draft = being written; review = structurally complete, awaits human check; stable = human-reviewed, citable. Only the user sets stable — agents must not self-promote.

author.description: Who produced the content. human = user; llm = unreviewed LLM; mixed = LLM draft + human edits.

bibkey.description: BibTeX citation key. Required when type = source; matches the entry in output/bibtex/references.bib.

based_on.description: Provenance of the ingested text for type=source. original = the cited work itself (default; field may be omitted); review/preprint/prior-version = a user-approved substitute ingested because the original could not be acquired. Replace with original on re-ingest of the original. Set by ingest-source; see its 'Provenance of substitutes' section.

hypothesis.description: Linked hypothesis slug from the research plan. Used on type = synthesis.

bibliography.description: Relative path to the project's BibTeX file (typically ../../output/bibtex/references.bib). Optional; only needed if a page is rendered standalone via Quarto. In the plain-Markdown wiki, citations resolve when the page is pulled into output/.

methodology.description: Optional override for project-level methodology. Drives whether pre-registration gates apply. Defaults to the project-level setting in the root CLAUDE.md frontmatter.

wikidata_qid.description: Wikidata entity ID (e.g. Q173799 for Tel Megiddo). Used on type=entity. Resolvable via dao-paper-search-mcp resolve_author / resolve_site.

idai_gazetteer_id.description: iDAI.gazetteer ID (e.g. 2048473). Used on type=entity for archaeological places. Resolvable via dao-paper-search-mcp resolve_site.

gnd_id.description: GND (Gemeinsame Normdatei) authority record (e.g. 118533533). Used on type=entity for persons in German-language scholarship.

relations.description: Optional structured, confidence-tagged relations to other wiki pages. Complements free-text wikilinks and makes relation type and confidence machine-readable; consumed by scripts/wiki-to-graph.py and validated by scripts/lint-wiki.py. Pages without this field remain valid.

target.description: Target page slug (filename without extension), e.g. finkelstein-2003. Must resolve to an existing knowledge page (checked by lint-wiki.py).

type.description: Relation type. Free vocabulary; common values: cites, contradicts, builds-on, mentions, supports.

confidence.description: extracted = explicitly supported by the source (e.g. verbatim quote with page); inferred = added by the model; ambiguous = relation unclear. The inferred+ambiguous share is reported as the inference-rate by lint-wiki.py.

because.description: Optional one-line rationale for the relation (why A relates to B), ideally with a quote or page reference. Recorded per edge, shown in the graph viz and queries; the natural place to ground an inferred relation when hardening it to extracted.
